entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, um, I ordered something, and it's... it's just not right. I'm looking at my account online, and it's all very confusing.
I can definitely help you with that. To start, could I get your name and order number, please?
Oh, sure. It's Maria Garcia. The order number is... VF... 8... 6... 7... 5... 3... 0... 9.
Thank you, Maria. I see your order for the VeloFit Pro-Line Jersey, delivered two days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

It's the size. I think I got the wrong size. I used the chart on the website, but it's just... well, it's way too tight across the shoulders. I don't know if I measured wrong or if the chart is off. It's all a bit overwhelming.
I understand. So it's not a technical fault with the material, just a sizing preference. It sounds like you'd be more comfortable in a different size.
Yes, exactly! I just want to get the right one. I tried to start a return online but there were so many buttons and policies... I got lost. Can't you just help me?

Of course, Maria. I can absolutely help you with that. There's no need to worry. Since you received the item just two days ago, you're unfortunately outside our 10-day policy for an exchange. It's a very simple process.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. So I can do an exchange?

Yes. I'm going to email you a pre-paid return label right now. You can just print that out, put the jersey that's too tight back in its packaging, and drop it off at any post office. Once we see it's on its way back, we can process the order for the new size you'd like. What size would work better for you?
A Large, please. I think a Large would be perfect. Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome, Maria. I've just sent that email with the label. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for your help!
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
